stem: In its historic form, what did the Australian Childhood Immunisation Register record?

options.text: Only vaccines given to Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander children
Details of childhood vaccinations for children under 7 years
Only vaccines given after overseas travel

explanation: The historic Australian Childhood Immunisation Register recorded childhood immunisation details for children under 7 years. It has since been replaced by the broader Australian Immunisation Register.
